nodes.label: golangci-lint configuration
nodes.rationale: Linters default to none and tests are enabled; only the listed analyzers run.

nodes.label: Enabled linters
nodes.rationale: errcheck, govet, ineffassign, staticcheck, unused, misspell, and gosec are the only enabled linters.

nodes.label: gosec install and path exclusions
nodes.rationale: G204 and G702 are excluded because subprocesses with variables are expected for install tooling. G304 and G703 are excluded because file paths from config are intentional.

nodes.label: goimports local prefix
nodes.rationale: Formatters gofmt and goimports treat github.com/noderings/cli as the local import prefix.

nodes.label: Unused linter goimports settings
nodes.rationale: linters.settings also sets a goimports local prefix, but goimports is not in linters.enable. It is only enabled as a formatter.

nodes.label: Generated API path exclusion
nodes.rationale: internal/api/generated is excluded from both linters and formatters.

nodes.label: Test file linter exclusions
nodes.rationale: gosec and errcheck do not run on _test.go files.

nodes.label: nr multi-arch build
nodes.rationale: Static binaries (CGO_ENABLED=0) for linux, darwin, and windows on amd64 and arm64. Windows arm64 is ignored.

nodes.label: Version ldflags
nodes.rationale: Release builds strip symbols and inject version, commit, and buildDate into internal/cli.

nodes.label: Release archives
nodes.rationale: linux and darwin ship tar.gz; windows ships zip. Archives include LICENSE, README.md, and CHANGELOG.md.

nodes.label: Release changelog filters
nodes.rationale: Generated release notes drop docs:, test:, and ci: commits plus merge commits so the GitHub release stays on product changes.

nodes.label: GitHub release noderings/cli
nodes.rationale: Publishes to noderings/cli as v{{.Version}}, not as a draft, with prerelease auto.

nodes.label: Snapshot version template
nodes.rationale: Snapshot builds use {{ incpatch .Version }}-next.

nodes.label: 1.0.16 Pterodactyl install
nodes.rationale: nr cluster register --pterodactyl installs the game server operator, alone or with --hypervisor-driver. nr cluster install-pterodactyl adds it later. nr cluster install-hypervisor adds a hypervisor on an agent registered for game servers only. Panel URL, keys, and user id come from flags or PTERODACTYL_* env vars.

nodes.label: 1.0.15 operator chart pin 0.1.9
nodes.rationale: Register and operator upgrade pin Proxmox, SolusVM, and VirtFusion charts at 0.1.9 for hook provider Secret injection. Existing agents stay until upgrade or --reinstall-operator. Harbor image tags are v0.1.9.

nodes.label: 1.0.14 operator upgrade
nodes.rationale: nr cluster operator upgrade bumps hypervisor CRD and operator charts and the Harbor v* image tag while reusing cluster Secrets. Resume --reinstall-operator does the same unless credentials are passed to rotate tokens. In-place upgrade uses Helm --reset-then-reuse-values. vncGateway.image.repository is pinned to Harbor because retired harbor.nrings.io values cannot stick. ~/.nr/bin is prepended so Helm from register is found.

nodes.label: 1.0.13 operator chart pins
nodes.rationale: New installs pin Proxmox 0.1.3, SolusVM 0.1.4, and VirtFusion 0.1.8. Harbor image tags are v0.1.3, v0.1.4, and v0.1.8 so they do not collide with Helm OCI chart tags. Existing agents stay until --reinstall-operator.

nodes.label: 1.0.12 Liqo inbound proxy
nodes.rationale: Inbound peering goes through the Liqo API server proxy when the provider API is not publicly reachable (NAT or RFC1918 --agent-ip). Liqo is pinned to v0.0.0-3f1654f0. Deregister unoffloads vnc-gateway and wipes leftover mothership ForeignCluster, tenant, and operator objects, including with --skip-api. An existing NamespaceOffloading is remapped when the remote namespace name changes.

nodes.label: 1.0.11 required org id
nodes.rationale: nr cluster register requires --org-id or NR_ORGANIZATION_ID. The CLI no longer lists organizations. Authenticate with a service-account token; --org-id only sets X-Organization-ID and cannot replace a valid token.

nodes.label: 1.0.10 public Harbor Liqo images
nodes.rationale: Liqo install images are pinned to public Harbor nrings so nr cluster register can pull without credentials.

nodes.label: 1.0.9 persist hypervisor driver
nodes.rationale: The hypervisor driver is persisted on the agent during register. Liqo, operators, and the VNC gateway are pulled from public Harbor nrings.

nodes.label: 1.0.8 echo prompts and block leftover k3s
nodes.rationale: CLI token and sudo prompts are echoed. Re-register is blocked when leftover k3s is present.

nodes.label: 1.0.7 echo VirtFusion tokens
nodes.rationale: VirtFusion Global API and User API token prompts echo while pasting so it is obvious the paste landed.

nodes.label: 1.0.6 VirtFusion user API
nodes.rationale: VirtFusion register collects a client username, numeric user id, and User API token in addition to the Global Admin token. The VirtFusion operator chart is pinned to 0.1.4.

nodes.label: 1.0.5 drop organization id
nodes.rationale: This release dropped --organization-id and NR_ORGANIZATION_ID so authenticated commands listed organizations and used the account provider organization. Later 1.0.11 required the flag again.

nodes.label: 1.0.4 skip hypervisor TLS verify
nodes.rationale: Hypervisor API TLS verification is skipped on install for VirtFusion, Proxmox, and SolusVM. No flag or env var is required.

nodes.label: 1.0.3 Harbor registry pin
nodes.rationale: Operator image registry is pinned to harbor.noderings.com.

nodes.label: 1.0.2 register hardening
nodes.rationale: VirtFusion API token prompts echo. Trailing slashes are stripped from Proxmox, VirtFusion, and SolusVM API URLs. Mimir write tokens are issued via API instead of prompting. Register fails if --agent-ip is not on a local interface.

nodes.label: 1.0.1 organization header
nodes.rationale: --organization-id and NR_ORGANIZATION_ID send X-Organization-ID so OAuth logins hit the provider tenant. Register listed provider orgs when the flag was omitted. Superseded by the 1.0.11 service-account requirement.

nodes.label: 1.0.0 nr CLI
nodes.rationale: Introduces the nr CLI for provider authentication, agents, service accounts, and cluster registration with Proxmox, VirtFusion, and SolusVM 2, plus checkpoint/resume, verify, status, health, logs, debug, deregister, the GitHub Release installer, and GoReleaser multi-arch binaries.

nodes.label: 0.1.0 initial public release
nodes.rationale: Listed as the initial public release with date TBD. Whether it shipped separately from 1.0.0 is not stated.

nodes.label: Retired harbor.nrings.io
nodes.rationale: harbor.nrings.io values cannot stick; operator upgrade pins vncGateway.image.repository to Harbor.

nodes.label: Leftover k3s re-register block
nodes.rationale: Re-register is blocked when leftover k3s remains so a partial install is not layered onto an existing node.

nodes.label: Mimir write tokens via API
nodes.rationale: Register issues Mimir write tokens through the API instead of prompting.

nodes.label: Development setup
nodes.rationale: Clone noderings/cli, download modules, then make build and make test. Go must match go.mod. golangci-lint and govulncheck are optional.

nodes.label: Pull request checks
nodes.rationale: Before a PR, run make fmt, vet, lint, test, and vuln. CI must pass tests, lint, and govulncheck. Update README or docs when user-facing behavior changes.

nodes.label: Do not edit generated API
nodes.rationale: Files under internal/api/generated/ are generated. Hand edits would be overwritten and are excluded from lint.

nodes.label: Code style
nodes.rationale: Go packages live under internal/. Prefer small commits. Handle errors instead of ignoring them with _. Do not commit secrets, tokens, kubeconfigs, or hypervisor instances files.

nodes.label: Apache License 2.0
nodes.rationale: Contributions are licensed under Apache License 2.0.

nodes.label: NodeRings CLI
nodes.rationale: nr connects a dedicated Ubuntu VM as an agent cluster: it authenticates to NodeRings, registers the agent, and installs the local stack used to run customer virtual machines.

nodes.label: Agent VM requirements
nodes.rationale: Linux, Ubuntu 22.04+ recommended, for nr cluster register. Needs curl, tar, sudo, outbound HTTPS to GitHub Releases and api.noderings.com, and a provider organization approved for marketplace listing.

nodes.label: scripts/install.sh
nodes.rationale: The recommended installer fetches the latest linux or macOS amd64 or arm64 release into /usr/local/bin. NR_INSTALL_DIR overrides the location.

nodes.label: Service account token
nodes.rationale: On the agent VM use a service account token via NR_API_TOKEN, then nr auth status. Do not run nr auth login on the agent VM. Login is for a laptop, for example to create the first service account.

nodes.label: nr auth login
nodes.rationale: OAuth login is for a laptop. Do not run it on the agent VM.

nodes.label: Provider organization review
nodes.rationale: Creating agents and nr cluster register stay blocked until the organization is approved. Those commands print Provider organization review is pending.

nodes.label: nr cluster register
nodes.rationale: Run on the Ubuntu VM that will host the agent. Requires name, agent IP, gateway region, and org id. Prompts for hypervisor credentials unless an instances file is passed. One organization should use one hypervisor driver.

nodes.label: Organization id header
nodes.rationale: --org-id or NR_ORGANIZATION_ID is required and only sends X-Organization-ID. A missing or unauthorized token still fails. A token from another organization cannot register into this one.

nodes.label: Agent IP
nodes.rationale: --agent-ip must be assigned to a local interface. k3s uses it as --node-ip. A placeholder such as 1.1.1.1 fails preflight.

nodes.label: Hypervisor driver
nodes.rationale: The CLI uses the organization driver: proxmox, virtfusion, or solusvm. Pass --hypervisor-driver only to confirm it; a mismatch is rejected. pterodactyl is not a hypervisor driver.

nodes.label: Pterodactyl game server operator
nodes.rationale: After the agent is registered, nr cluster install-pterodactyl installs the game server operator beside the hypervisor agent.

nodes.label: Register resume
nodes.rationale: nr cluster register --resume continues an interrupted registration for the same name and org id.

nodes.label: nr cluster operator upgrade
nodes.rationale: Upgrades the operator later without re-entering hypervisor tokens.

nodes.label: Reinstall operator
nodes.rationale: nr cluster register --resume --reinstall-operator reuses existing Secrets unless credentials are passed. That path is for rotating tokens.

nodes.label: CLI output and exit codes
nodes.rationale: Diagnostic messages go to stderr. --output json makes stdout machine-readable. Exit 0 is success, 1 is runtime failure, 2 is usage error.

nodes.label: User config ~/.nr/config.yaml
nodes.rationale: Optional. Production API default is https://api.noderings.com.

nodes.label: Supported versions
nodes.rationale: main and 0.x are supported.

nodes.label: Private vulnerability reporting
nodes.rationale: Do not open a public GitHub issue. Report via GitHub security advisories. Include impact, repro steps, and affected components (nr CLI, install tooling, auth/token storage). Acknowledgement is aimed at within a few business days.

nodes.label: Operator token storage
nodes.rationale: Prefer OS keyring token storage. File fallback writes tokens as JSON with mode 0600 and is not encrypted. Do not use --dev or api.tls_insecure true against production. Rotate service account tokens and never commit them.

nodes.label: CI workflow
nodes.rationale: Runs on workflow_dispatch, push to main, and pull requests to main. Concurrency cancels in-progress runs for the same ref.

nodes.label: CI test job
nodes.rationale: On ubuntu-latest with contents read: checkout, setup-go from go.mod, go mod download, go vet, and go test -race -count=1.

nodes.label: CI coverage soft floor
nodes.rationale: Coverage excludes internal/api/generated. The soft floor fails the job below 15 percent, with a comment to raise it toward about 25-30 percent over time.

nodes.label: CI lint job
nodes.rationale: Runs golangci-lint-action v7 at golangci-lint v2.1.6 with a 5 minute timeout.

nodes.label: CI govulncheck job
nodes.rationale: Installs golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck and runs govulncheck ./...

nodes.label: Release workflow
nodes.rationale: On tags matching v*, with contents write, checks out full history and runs GoReleaser release --clean.

nodes.label: GoReleaser action
nodes.rationale: goreleaser/goreleaser-action v6, distribution goreleaser, version ~> v2, args release --clean, using GITHUB_TOKEN. fetch-depth 0 so changelog generation can see history.

nodes.label: Default CLI config
nodes.rationale: Shipped defaults for api, auth, logging, downloads, k3s, Calico, and Liqo. A normal production install does not require a user config file.

nodes.label: Default API settings
nodes.rationale: base_url https://api.noderings.com, timeout 20 seconds, tls_insecure false, optional ca_cert_path.

nodes.label: Default frontend URL
nodes.rationale: frontend.base_url is https://noderings.com.

nodes.label: Default auth settings
nodes.rationale: auth.token is empty and may be set via NR_API_TOKEN. token_file is ~/.nr/tokens for nr auth login. refresh_threshold is 300 seconds and applies to OAuth tokens only.

nodes.label: Default logging
nodes.rationale: level info, file ~/.nr/nr.log.

nodes.label: Default downloads
nodes.rationale: Empty temp_dir uses the system temp. keep_on_error is false. verify_checksums is true.

nodes.label: Default k3s install
nodes.rationale: Install script https://get.k3s.io, kubeconfig mode 600, cluster CIDR 10.200.0.0/16, service CIDR 10.201.0.0/16, flannel backend none, disables network policy and traefik. Empty version uses latest stable. Minimum v1.25.0.

nodes.label: Default Calico
nodes.rationale: Calico v3.30.2, rollout timeout 10m, minimum v3.26.0. Empty version would mean latest.

nodes.label: Default Liqo install
nodes.rationale: Pinned to v0.0.0-3f1654f0, timeout 10m, gateway service NodePort on the provider, pod offloading Local, pod and service CIDRs matching k3s. Chart oci://harbor.noderings.com/nrings/liqo at chart version 0.0.0-3f1654f0. API server URL defaults to https://<agent-ip>:6443 during registration.

nodes.label: Inbound API proxy mode
nodes.rationale: How the control plane reaches this cluster API server when it peers back. auto proxies through the Liqo tunnel only when the API server address is not public. always and never are the other modes. Default is auto.

nodes.label: Harbor nrings project
nodes.rationale: Liqo chart OCI reference is oci://harbor.noderings.com/nrings/liqo.

nodes.label: Configuration
nodes.rationale: Global config lives at ~/.nr/config.yaml. A normal production install does not need a config file.

nodes.label: API URL precedence
nodes.rationale: Order is --api-url, then NR_API_URL, then api.base_url, defaulting to https://api.noderings.com.

nodes.label: Production TLS verification
nodes.rationale: Do not set tls_insecure true against production.

nodes.label: Token resolution order
nodes.rationale: NR_API_TOKEN, also NODERINGS_API_TOKEN, NR_TOKEN, and NODERINGS_TOKEN, then auth.token, then OS keyring or auth.token_file for OAuth.

nodes.label: Token file mode 0600
nodes.rationale: File fallback stores tokens as JSON with mode 0600 and is not encrypted. Prefer the OS keyring for interactive use.

nodes.label: Logging config
nodes.rationale: level info and file ~/.nr/nr.log.

nodes.label: Hypervisor credentials on the agent
nodes.rationale: nr cluster register installs the matching operator after peering. Credentials stay on the agent cluster as Kubernetes Secrets. NodeRings does not store them. TLS verification is off for Proxmox, VirtFusion, and SolusVM with no flag required.

nodes.label: Proxmox credentials
nodes.rationale: Single instance env PROXMOX_URL, PROXMOX_USERNAME, PROXMOX_TOKEN_ID, PROXMOX_TOKEN_SECRET, or --proxmox-instances-file with mode 600.

nodes.label: VirtFusion credentials
nodes.rationale: Needs URL, global token, user API token, numeric user id, and panel username, or --virtfusion-instances-file mode 0600. Create a normal client user, not an admin, so VMs are created as that user and the operator can POST /api/server/{uuid}/build with userData.

nodes.label: SolusVM 2 credentials
nodes.rationale: SOLUSVM_URL and SOLUSVM_TOKEN, or --solusvm-instances-file. Use the SolusVM 2 management-node HTTPS URL on port 443, not SolusVM 1 port 5656.

nodes.label: Pterodactyl credentials
nodes.rationale: Not a --hypervisor-driver value. Register the hypervisor agent first, then nr cluster install-pterodactyl. The command asks for the panel URL, both keys, and the panel user id. PTERODACTYL_APPLICATION_KEY and PTERODACTYL_CLIENT_KEY skip those prompts. Keys are stored in a Secret on the agent and are not sent to NodeRings.

nodes.label: Registration checkpoints
nodes.rationale: Checkpoints live under ~/.nr/ and must not be copied between machines. Never commit tokens, kubeconfigs, or instances files. If a hypervisor token leaked, rotate it and re-run register --resume --reinstall-operator. Chart-only upgrades use nr cluster operator upgrade and do not rewrite Secrets.

nodes.label: Installation
nodes.rationale: Install nr on the machine that will register the agent, usually a dedicated Ubuntu VM.

nodes.label: GitHub release installer
nodes.rationale: install.sh detects linux or darwin and amd64 or arm64, downloads the latest GitHub Release archive, verifies checksums.txt when present, and installs nr to /usr/local/bin, using sudo if needed. NR_INSTALL_DIR overrides the location.

nodes.label: Build from source
nodes.rationale: Requires Go matching go.mod. make build then install build/nr to /usr/local/bin.

nodes.label: go install
nodes.rationale: go install github.com/noderings/cli/cmd/nr@latest. GOPATH/bin must be on PATH.

nodes.label: README sign-in anchor
nodes.rationale: The install doc says next authenticate at README.md#sign-in. The README section is titled Authenticate (service account), so the anchor may not match.

nodes.label: Unauthenticated status
nodes.rationale: If nr auth status shows unauthenticated, set NR_API_TOKEN from a service account and confirm https://api.noderings.com is reachable. Do not use nr auth login on the agent VM.

nodes.label: Pending marketplace review
nodes.rationale: Login can succeed while the provider organization is not marketplace-approved. Identity and organization commands still work. Creating agents, generating install commands, and peering stay blocked until review completes.

nodes.label: TLS and certificate errors
nodes.rationale: Prefer a proper CA via api.ca_cert_path. api.tls_insecure true and --dev skip verification and are not for production.

nodes.label: Register prechecks
nodes.rationale: Use a dedicated Ubuntu 22.04+ VM with free ports including 6443. --skip-prechecks is only for when the risk is understood.

nodes.label: Agent IP preflight
nodes.rationale: --agent-ip is passed to k3s as --node-ip. It must exist on this VM, not a docs placeholder and not a NAT address that is only visible upstream.

nodes.label: Register permission denied
nodes.rationale: NR_API_TOKEN must be a service account JWT for this provider organization, --org-id must match, and the role must include agent permissions. --org-id cannot authenticate by itself.

nodes.label: Resume after failure
nodes.rationale: nr cluster register --resume uses the same name and org id. Checkpoints live under ~/.nr/. nr cluster status and nr cluster debug show details.

nodes.label: Operator chart upgrade
nodes.rationale: nr cluster operator upgrade reuses Helm values and Kubernetes Secrets and does not need NR_API_TOKEN or --org-id. To rotate hypervisor credentials, use --resume --reinstall-operator. If CRDs were first installed as the operator subchart, upgrade applies the dedicated CRD charts in place because Helm 3.16 cannot take ownership, and keeps the CRDs when the operator subchart is disabled.

nodes.label: Post-register verification
nodes.rationale: nr cluster verify retries the check. Failed verify or health exits 1. Bad flags exit 2.

nodes.label: Deregister
nodes.rationale: nr cluster deregister removes the agent. --force continues after partial failures. Review leftovers on the VM after a force teardown.

nodes.label: Cluster diagnostics
nodes.rationale: status, info, health, logs, and debug. debug writes a report under ~/.nr/debug-<timestamp>/. Redact tokens before sharing.

nodes.label: Liqo provider values overlay
nodes.rationale: Shared Liqo Helm values applied via liqoctl install --values. Images point at public harbor.noderings.com/nrings for anonymous pull.

nodes.label: Gateway masquerade bypass
nodes.rationale: networking.fabric.config.gatewayMasqueradeBypass is required with Calico and is also helpful on k3s or Flannel nested VMs.

nodes.label: Liqo external CIDR
nodes.rationale: ipam.externalCIDR 10.72.0.0/16 must stay distinct from the control-plane cluster CIDR (default 10.70.0.0/16) so in-band proxy remapping works.

nodes.label: Public Liqo component images
nodes.rationale: Fabric, gateway, wireguard, geneve, controller manager, webhook, CRD replicator, metric agent, cert creator, telemetry, virtual kubelet, uninstaller, proxy, CRD upgrade, and IPAM images are harbor.noderings.com/nrings/*.

nodes.label: Proxmox CRD reflection allowlist
nodes.rationale: AllowList reflection for vm.proxmox.com/v1alpha1 proxmoxnodes, proxmoxvms, firewallrulesets, vmbackups, vmsnapshots, and vncrequests. Instances need annotation liqo.io/allow-reflection true.

nodes.label: VirtFusion CRD reflection allowlist
nodes.rationale: AllowList reflection for vm.virtfusion.com/v1alpha1 virtfusioncontrols, virtfusionnodes, virtfusionvms, and virtfusionvncrequests.

nodes.label: SolusVM CRD reflection allowlist
nodes.rationale: AllowList reflection for vm.solusvm.com/v1alpha1 solusvmcontrols, solusvmnodes, solusvmvms, and solusvmvncrequests.

nodes.label: Pterodactyl CRD reflection allowlist
nodes.rationale: AllowList reflection for gs.pterodactyl.com/v1alpha1 pterodactylservers, pterodactylactions, pterodactylgamecatalogs, pterodactylcontrols, pterodactylnodes, and pterodactylwebsocketrequests.

nodes.label: Kopf annotation reflection skip
nodes.rationale: Reflection skips kopf.zalando.org and the virtfusion, solusvm, proxmox, and pterodactyl operator last-handled-configuration annotations.

nodes.label: NodeRings API
nodes.rationale: OpenAPI 3.0.0 spec titled NodeRings API, version 1.0, contact NodeRings at https://noderings.com. The CLI generated client is produced from this file.

nodes.label: Payment provider webhooks
nodes.rationale: POST /api/v1/webhooks/{provider} receives Stripe, PayPal, and similar payloads. The implementation reads the raw body and headers for signature verification.
